name: Andre Wijaya
message: I was charged twice for my June subscription and the second charge put my card over its limit. Please refund the duplicate immediately, this is unacceptable.

name: Siti Rahmawati
message: I cannot log in at all since this morning. It keeps saying invalid session and I have a client presentation in two hours. I need this fixed now.

name: Bayu Pratama
message: All of my saved projects from last week have disappeared. Three days of work are just gone. Is there any way to recover them? I am panicking.

name: Clara Tanuwijaya
message: This is the third outage this month. If it happens again I am cancelling our team plan and moving to a competitor. We cannot run our business on this.

name: Daniel Hutapea
message: When I opened my dashboard I could see another customer's invoices and email address. This is a serious privacy problem and you need to look into it today.

name: Mega Lestari
message: The editor crashes every time I paste a large table. It has happened more than ten times today and I keep losing my changes. This is blocking my work.

name: Rizky Ananda
message: I opened a support ticket four days ago about billing and nobody has replied. Very disappointed with the response time for a paying customer.

name: Putri Maharani
message: There is a bug where the date filter resets when I switch tabs. I found a workaround by refreshing, but it would be nice to have it fixed.

name: Fajar Nugroho
message: The new settings page is confusing. I could not find where to change my notification preferences and gave up after ten minutes.

name: Indah Permata
message: The reports section takes about thirty seconds to load every time. It is usable but slow enough to be frustrating during a busy day.

name: Hendra Saputra
message: Would love to see an integration with Google Sheets so I can export my data automatically. Right now I copy and paste everything by hand.

name: Nadia Kusuma
message: Exporting to PDF cuts off the last column of wide tables. Not urgent, but it makes the reports look unfinished when I share them.

name: Tomy Halim
message: Small thing: there is a typo on the billing page, it says recieve instead of receive.

name: Vina Oktaviani
message: Great app overall. Only wish there was a dark mode for late night work. My eyes would thank you.

name: Galih Pranoto
message: Quick question, does the Pro plan include the team workspace feature, or is that only on the Business plan? The pricing page is a little unclear.

name: Sherly Wibowo
message: Just want to say the new onboarding flow is fantastic. Got my whole team set up in under ten minutes. Keep up the great work.

name: Reza Firmansyah
message: Honestly love the product and use it every day. One suggestion would be keyboard shortcuts for the most common actions.

name: Dewi Anggraini
message: The mobile app keeps logging me out every few hours on Android. On desktop it is fine, so it seems specific to mobile.

name: Arif Setiawan
message: My payment keeps failing when I try to upgrade to the annual plan, so I am stuck on monthly. I want to pay you, please help me give you money.

name: Lia Susanti
message: I am getting way too many email notifications, sometimes five for the same comment thread. Is there a way to batch them?

name: Yoga Mahendra
message: The API docs for the webhook section are a bit thin. A working example payload would help a lot.

name: Maya Sari
message: Under the new regulations I would like to request that you delete all of my personal data from your systems. Please confirm once this is done.

name: Eko Prasetyo
message: I just started the trial and I am a bit lost on how to invite my teammates. A short walkthrough would have helped.

name: Ratna Dewi
message: Thank you to your support agent Rina, she solved my import issue in five minutes and was very kind about it.

name: Bagus Santoso
message: The numbers in my monthly revenue report do not match what I see in the live dashboard. I need to trust these figures before I send them to my board.

name: Wulan Safitri
message: Love the recent speed improvements. The app feels much snappier. A widget for the home screen would be the cherry on top.
